verdict.rationale: telli documents an in-app agent builder with drafts and revisions (telli-docs-28) and an AI assistant, Charlie, that builds and refines agents (telli-docs-11). Handoffs are covered by transfer tools that move a call to another agent or number (telli-docs-31). Workflows with triggers also exist (telli-docs-1), but nothing shows a visual, multi-step conversation-flow canvas. Missing for 10: evidence of a visual flow builder, conversation branching logic, state/node management, and independent corroboration of no-code flow design.
